notes.title: Prologue and Episode 1 Part 1
notes.notes:
[i][u][b]A Huge new update for Life Matters:[/b][/u][/i]

[u][b]Game Completion[/b][/u]

The latest update has the game to approximately 35% completion. With more content coming soon.
One Playthrough will be around [i][b]2 hours and 50 minutes[/b][/i] will be higher or lower depending if you take different paths or more than one playthrough

[u][b]New Character Models[/b][/u]

I have introduced new character models to many of the characters to make them look more like how I envisioned them to be.

Especially with Delilah's character model. I tried not to edit the character model too much from the original update and it just wasn't working so the new Delilah Character model works much better I think.

[u][b]Prologue & Episode 1 Part 1 Added[/b][/u]

The latest update significantly expands the gaming experience by introducing the continuation of the Prologue with the addition of Prologue Part 2, along with the introduction of Episode 1 Part 1. This update brings a substantial amount of new content to the game. The duration of gameplay can vary based on the diverse paths available to players, with a typical playthrough now averaging around 2 hours and 50 minutes. Notably, the actual time may fluctuate depending on individual choices and the specific paths taken, offering players the flexibility to experience a shorter or longer duration based on their decisions, including the option to navigate the fastest path within the game.

[b]Be on the look out for each path you can take for each path may not be clear.[/b] 

[u][b]Prologue Part 2[/b][/u]

Prologue Part 2 unfolds as an immersive free-roam event, inviting players to encounter not only the six central characters but also an additional fifteen optional characters available for interaction. There will multiple ways to get things from people and will have to interact with the 6 main characters to continue the story. Which you can end the night in multiple ways.

[u][b]The Optional Characters[/b][/u]

The game focuses on six main characters, but throws in fifteen optional ones for extra flavor. It's up to you whether you want to chat with them or skip it. These optional characters show up at key points, and how you talk to them can either help or hurt you down the line. It's a straightforward system that lets you shape your own gaming journey.

[u][b]Later Updates[/b][/u]

Anticipate ongoing updates with fresh content; we're not just tweaking what's there, except for bug fixes, grammar edits, or animation improvements. I'll share the next update once there's a substantial addition to offer. From the depths of my gratitude. 

[i][u][b]Thank You For Playing[/b][/u][/i]

I sincerely hope you relish the game and appreciate your involvement in this shared journey. Thank you for being a part of it.

Sincerely,
               Alexander Games

notes.title: Life Matters Update!
notes.notes:
[b][u]Whole New World[/u][/b]

The Game has been overhauled with better images and better models. You'll see more diversity in the characters and scenes to make a better story.

Achievements have been added to the game and more will come with each update.

New Story Paths: With having new everything there will be more choices effecting story paths and getting new choices.

New Gameplay Elements such as new stats such as charisma allowing the player to gain charisma throughout the game then have charisma checks throughout the game which will influence other people.
Another is Life Points will contain through most choices making you more Introverted or Extroverted through life. The Last thing is Likability with this is how much people like you allowing them to do certain story paths throughout the game.

All the saves from the previous update will not work with this update.

[b]I hope you enjoy the update and will be updating it more frequently from now on.[/b]
